messages:
arjun: Hey team — I’m about to open my first PR against runtime: small lint change + tweak to a test fixture. TL;DR: what’s the preferred branching + review flow here? also what CI checks should I run locally before pushing?
mai: welcome! :wave: For runtime: branch off main, use feature/<yourname>/short-desc. keep PRs small (<= 200 LOC ideally). mark as draft if unsure.
ryan: +1 to mai. Also add a clear PR description with why, plus a perf note if it touches hot paths.
olivia: reviewers: @ryan handles runtime core, @marcus for infra changes. If it’s only lint/test fixtures, ping me and @mai. We tend to assign 2 reviewers.
sam: local prechecks: run `./devci/checks.sh` and `yarn test:unit` (or `pytest -q` for python bits). If you touch formatting run `pre-commit run --all-files`.
marcus: for CI flakiness: run `make smoke` which exercises the lightweight integration suite. If you’re seeing a lot of unrelated failures, append `[skip ci]` in the commit message for WIP drafts when you don't want CI triggered.
devbot: CI triggered: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/8892 — status: pending (will report back in thread).
arjun: thanks — couple nitpicks: are we squashing on merge? and do we rebase or merge main?
mai: squash commits on merge is standard for small fixes. Rebase onto main before final review to get clean diffs.
ryan: prefer `git rebase origin/main` and force-push your branch. Keep history tidy.
olivia: labels: add `area/runtime`, `size/small`, and `needs-review`. If it’s a docs change add `docs`.
sam: tip: if you want faster review, drop a short checklist in the PR description: what you ran locally, links to relevant tests, and screenshots/logs for failures.
arjun: great — last Q: any code style/linters specific to runtime I should run?
marcus: runtime uses clang-format (C++), black/isort for py, and eslint + prettier for ts. There’s a repo-level `CONTRIBUTING.md` with exact commands — search root for it.
arjun: found CONTRIBUTING.md, ran checks, opened draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1423 — tagging reviewers. thanks everyone :tada:
mai: nice! leaving a small comment on the PR shortly. :eyes:
devbot: CI update: build 8892 passed unit checks, integration queued.
ryan: once CI passes, switch to ready-for-review and assign reviewers. Good first PR!
